status: prepared authenticated password-change backend; UI and recovery unfinished; not published
scope: Authenticated-owner-only password change requires the current password, preserves exact input, applies the registration new-password policy and shared five-per-minute/concurrent credential bounds.

Mongo projects the stored hash and conditionally replaces only that observed hash; simultaneous old-password proofs cannot overwrite each other. No role, wallet, character, email or recovery ownership mutation.

A generated replacement resume token is prepared before credential mutation and installed only after confirmed storage success. An uncertain database acknowledgement revokes old resume access and reports uncertainty, without automatic replay or a false rollback promise.

Login credential verification now holds the account handoff lock; resume resolves its server-bound account, then revalidates/consumes under that lock. Queued stale proofs cannot take ownership after a credential/token change.
Correlated protected-protocol responses contain no old/new password or storage errors. The player-facing form and safe recovery method remain separate unfinished work.
